result.stdout:
SliceForge - Vertical Slice + Clean Architecture Generator

Commands:

  sliceforge new-solution --name EStore --namespace EStore --output "D:\Projects\EStore"

  sliceforge init --namespace EStore --output "D:\Projects\EStore"

  sliceforge add-feature --name CreateProduct --module Products --operation create --properties "Name:string,Price:decimal" --output "D:\Projects\EStore"

  sliceforge add-crud --entity Product --module Products --properties "Name:string,Price:decimal" --output "D:\Projects\EStore"

  sliceforge doctor --output "D:\Projects\EStore"

Options:

  --framework    Target framework for new-solution. Default: net10.0
  --output       Target folder
  --dry-run      Preview generated files without writing
  --force        Overwrite existing files
